Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the transparency of health care cost information.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transparency of health care cost information;and adding a new section to chapter 70.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All fees and charges for health care services and proceduresshall be disclosed by a health care provider licensed under Title 18RCW or facility licensed under Title 70 RCW, upon request of a patient. (2) Providers may, after disclosing charges and fees to a patient,refer the patient to the patient's insurer for specific information onthe insurer's negotiated charges and fees for services and procedures,and any costsharing responsibilities required of the patient.
